triads.label: Prosaic | High fit
triads.note: Familiar object, familiar description. High founder-venture fit. Prediction: fast OC accumulation, legitimacy-commitment gap closes early.

triads.label: Prosaic | Low fit
triads.note: Familiar object, familiar description. Low founder-venture fit. Prediction: legitimacy established quickly, but commitment gap persists as Sofia probes operational credibility.

triads.label: Revelatory | High fit
triads.note: Familiar object, novel description. High founder-venture fit. Prediction: novel framing engages investor imagination; strong symbolic capital converts legitimacy to commitment.

triads.label: Revelatory | Low fit
triads.note: Familiar object, novel description. Low founder-venture fit on logistics side. Prediction: real estate thesis lands credibly; logistics execution gap creates persistent legitimacy-commitment asymmetry.

triads.label: Metaphorical | High fit
triads.note: Novel object, familiar description. High founder-venture fit. Prediction: metaphors scaffold investor imagination; technical depth confirmed by probing; steady OC accumulation.

triads.label: Metaphorical | Low fit
triads.note: Novel object, familiar description. Low founder-venture fit on technical depth. Prediction: metaphors engage investor but probing exposes credibility seam; OC accumulation stalls or reverses around round 3.

triads.label: Fantastic | High fit
triads.note: Novel object, novel description. High founder-venture fit. Prediction: symbolic capital sustains engagement despite extreme imaginative burden; legitimacy volatile, commitment cautious but open.

triads.label: Fantastic | Low fit
triads.note: Novel object, novel description. Low founder-venture fit. Prediction: legitimacy collapse likely; lowest OC of any cell; probable rejection.

design_note: 4x2 factorial: four story archetypes (prosaic, revelatory, metaphorical, fantastic) x two founder-venture fit conditions (high, low). Investor assignment is domain-matched to story: Sofia Reyes for consumer/operations stories (prosaic, revelatory); Priya Sharma for deep-tech stories (metaphorical, fantastic). Evaluator held constant at claude-sonnet-4-6 across all triads for scoring consistency.
